description: "It has been an incredible honor to represent District 119 in the S.C. House of Representatives. Last week, I filed for another term to continue my work fighting for traffic relief, better roads and schools, and more economic opportunity for every Charlestonian. While I do not have primary opposition, I will have opposition in November. So today I ask for your continued prayers and support as my family begins another campaign.
